latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Growth Team Structure Planner skill.

- Generates a tailored proposal for structuring a cross-functional growth team at a Series A–B startup.
- Recommends either a product-led or independent team model, with rationale based on company context.
- Defines required roles (growth lead, PM, engineer, designer, data analyst, marketer) with job description stubs.
- Outlines executive sponsorship needs and suggests a kickoff meeting agenda.
- Produces two ready-to-present documents: growth-team-proposal.md (structure, roles, sponsorship) and kickoff-agenda.md (first team meeting plan).
- Activates for a wide range of prompts related to growth team design, hiring, org alignment, or pitching a growth function.
